label: GE PRESS 3 T, TE 35 ms (phantom)
description: GE P-file from FID-A: PRESS at 3 T, TE 35 ms, 32 channels, 16 averages and water frames, acquired in a spectroscopy phantom.
expectedResult: FID-A combines coils and aligns averages; LCModel fits it with the PRESS TE 35 ms basis and reports water-scaled concentrations for NAA, Cr, Cho, mI, Glu and Lac.

label: Philips PRESS 3 T, TE 35 ms, with T1 (tissue correction)
description: Philips SDAT/SPAR from Osprey (MIT): PRESS at 3 T, TE 35 ms, 30 mm voxel in the posterior cingulate, water reference, and the same session's T1 (defaced).
expectedResult: LCModel fits with the PRESS TE 35 ms basis; MindMap segments the T1, the Voxel view shows the box on it, and the table adds tissue-corrected concentrations (mmol/kg) from its GM, WM and CSF fractions.

label: Siemens SPECIAL 3 T, TE 8.5 ms (in vivo)
description: Siemens raw data (twix) from FID-A: SPECIAL at 2.89 T, TE 8.5 ms, 32 channels, 80 ISIS pairs, left DLPFC, with a separate water reference. 178 MB.
expectedResult: FID-A combines coils, aligns and combines the ISIS subspectra, removes bad averages and corrects drift; LCModel fits the result with the SPECIAL basis.

label: Siemens MEGA-PRESS 3 T, TE 68 ms (GABA)
description: Siemens raw data (twix) from FID-A: GABA-edited MEGA-PRESS at 2.89 T, TE 68 ms, 32 channels, 80 edit-ON/OFF pairs, left DLPFC. 86 MB.
expectedResult: FID-A combines coils, removes bad averages, corrects drift and aligns edit-ON to edit-OFF; LCModel fits the difference spectrum with the MEGA-PRESS basis and reports GABA+ and Glx relative to NAA+NAAG.

label: Philips MEGA-PRESS 3 T, TE 68 ms (GABA)
description: Philips SDAT/SPAR from Osprey (MIT): GABA-edited MEGA-PRESS at 3 T, TE 68 ms, 160 edit-ON/OFF pairs with a water reference. The file does not record editing; the app detects it. 10 MB.
expectedResult: The app finds alternate edit-OFF and edit-ON transients (NAA nearly erased in edit-ON), FID-A removes bad averages, corrects drift and aligns the subspectra, and LCModel fits GABA+ on the difference spectrum relative to NAA+NAAG.

label: Philips PRESS 3 T, TE 35 ms, two subjects (group)
description: Philips SDAT/SPAR from Osprey (MIT): PRESS at 3 T, TE 35 ms, 64 averages combined on the scanner, two subjects, each with a water reference. 80 kB.
expectedResult: The app pairs each spectrum with its own water reference and fits both subjects with the PRESS TE 35 ms basis in one run; the group table compares water-scaled concentrations and quality measures, and each subject has a printable report.

label: NIfTI-MRS PRESS 3 T, TE 35 ms, with water
description: Osprey's openly licensed Philips PRESS data, converted to NIfTI-MRS with spec2nii: 3 T, TE 35 ms, scanner-combined averages and a separate water reference.
expectedResult: LCModel fits the spectrum with the PRESS TE 35 ms basis and reports water-scaled concentrations. Download the concentration table, preprocessed spectrum and water reference.

label: LCModel test spectrum (Synthetic)
description: Synthetic: LCModel's own test case, a 3 T spectrum simulated with spant, with its basis set and control file. It checks the fit, not preprocessing.
expectedResult: The fit reproduces LCModel's reference output for this spectrum; the table matches LCModel run natively.
